method.approach: Chapter-level sim mapping (hand-curated from every sim's teaching text, challenge banks and embedded legacy node-id comments, matched against each chapter's node definitions), then per-node diagnostic coverage scoring of each node's 5-6 diagnostics (q+a+misconception) against the full text of the mapped sim component(s).
method.heuristic: A diagnostic counts covered when 0.65 * (IDF-weighted share of its question-stem terms present in the sim source text) + 0.35 * (share of its answer terms) >= 0.40. Both the diagnostic and the sim text are stemmed with the same light stemmer and matched by equality or shared prefix, plus a small curated synonym table (e.g. percent->'%', hcf->'highest common factor'). IDF is computed over the class's chapter documents so common academic vocabulary cannot fake coverage. GOLD = all diagnostics covered; PARTIAL = at least two diagnostics covered; MISSING = no mapped sim or fewer than two diagnostics covered. Lexical heuristic - conservative on metaphorical sims; boundary cases were hand-verified (see spot_checks).
limitations: Lexical term-presence scoring, not interaction testing: a sim may exercise a skill without naming it, or name it without a scored interaction.
Sims scoped to the legacy (pre-curriculum-change) syllabus deliver nothing to the current node index and count as unmapped topics.
Answer-key defect scan is structural (index range, duplicate options, numeric key type, % of arithmetic); it does not re-derive every computed answer.

spot_checks.description: 15 verdicts per class hand-verified against the actual sim interactions (stratified sample; fixed list recorded in the audit script).
